response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM r), k1 AS (SELECT r.rating, r.a, b.base FROM r CROSS JOIN b WHERE r.a > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mean1 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a, k1.base, m.mean1 FROM k1 CROSS JOIN m WHERE k1.a > m.mean1) SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(a - base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(a - mean1) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM k2

assumptions.assumption: Ratings with a NULL rating value are treated as their own group only if they exist; the verified data shows exactly 5 non-null ratings, so this does not affect the result.
If no rating survives both filters, the query returns one row of NULLs.
